brief.title: Uber-style personal trainer app
brief.summary: The client wants a cross-platform mobile and web application connecting clients with nearby personal trainers for booking and training. The goal is to provide a complete ecosystem including client booking, chat, ratings, trainer profiles, and an admin panel.
mustHaves: Simple app like uber but for personal trainers
Clients find trainers near them, book, pay, chat, rate

clientSignals.note: Extremely unrealistic budget for building a multi-platform app with iOS, Android, Web, and admin panel.
Unrealistic timeline of 2 weeks for a complex Uber-like product.
Requests unpaid test work ('build the login and booking screens. We will choose the best one').
Suggests moving communication off-platform to WhatsApp.

applicationInstructions: Before we hire you must do a small test: build the login and booking screens.
Contact me on WhatsApp to discuss faster.
questionsToAsk: Are you open to using a low-code or template-based solution given the $500 budget?
Can we scope this down to a simple MVP focusing only on the web version first?
Will compensation be provided for the requested login and booking screen test?

requirements.requirement: Simple app like uber but for personal trainers
requirements.evidence: Profile shows building a booking system and a React Native gym app, which transfers to the marketplace domain, but an Uber-style geo-matching model is new.

requirements.requirement: Clients find trainers near them, book, pay, chat, rate
requirements.evidence: Profile mentions online booking with Stripe deposits, but finding nearby trainers via location services, chat, and ratings are not explicitly mentioned.
Built a booking + reminders system for a 2-location dental practice.
Full-stack developer with Next.js, React, and Node.js experience, but direct admin panel experience is implied rather than explicitly detailed.
React Native (Expo) app for a gym chain, 15k installs, plus Next.js and React for web.

proofPoints.claim: Built a booking + reminders system for a 2-location dental practice using online booking and Stripe deposits.
proofPoints.whyItMatters: Demonstrates direct capability in handling client scheduling, calendar management, and payment processing.

proofPoints.claim: React Native (Expo) app for a gym chain, 15k installs.
proofPoints.whyItMatters: Proves cross-platform mobile app development experience specifically within the fitness industry.

gaps.gap: Uber-style geo-matching and real-time chat/rating features
gaps.honestFraming: Acknowledge that while booking and fitness mobile apps are fully covered, geo-location proximity search and chat features will be integrated using established libraries and patterns.

fit.angle: You should pick this freelancer because they combine cross-platform React Native fitness app experience with proven online booking and Stripe payment integration.

versions.proposal:
Ready to build your cross-platform personal trainer app with iOS, Android, and web access, plus a complete admin panel.

You need a system connecting clients with nearby personal trainers for booking, chat, ratings, and trainer profiles.

I built a React Native Expo app for a gym chain that reached 15k installs, and I developed a booking and reminders system for a 2-location dental practice that used online booking and Stripe deposits to drop no-shows from 11% to 4% in 3 months.

For the geo-matching and real-time chat features, I will integrate established libraries and patterns to handle proximity search and messaging reliably.

We can start the test with the login and booking screens right away. What is your preferred timeline for the initial review?

milestones.name: Login and Booking Screens
milestones.outcome: Functional authentication and booking flows for the test requirement.

milestones.name: Core Application and Admin Panel
milestones.outcome: iOS, Android, and web apps with trainer profiles, calendars, and admin controls.

milestones.name: Payments and Integrations
milestones.outcome: Stripe payment processing, chat features, and rating systems fully integrated.

scores.note: Starts by listing the project scope rather than engaging directly with the unique core challenge.
Mentions key features like cross-platform web and mobile access and the admin panel.
Accurately references the 15k-install gym app and the dental practice booking system from the profile.
Skims over the technical architecture for geo-matching and real-time chat.
Asks about timeline instead of taking the requested concrete step or mentioning WhatsApp.
Every claim strictly matches the provided freelancer profile without exaggeration.

edits: Change the hook to address the Uber-for-trainers matching requirement directly.
Change the close to mention connecting on WhatsApp as requested in the instructions.
Change the plan section to briefly outline how the login and booking test screens will be structured.
critique.verdict: A solid, honest proposal that accurately reflects the profile, but it misses some specific instructions like reaching out via WhatsApp.

state.job:
Need app like uber but for personal trainers

Simple app. Clients find trainers near them, book, pay, chat, rate. Trainers have profile and calendar. Admin panel. iOS and Android. Also web.

Budget $500. Need it in 2 weeks. Must be expert.

Before we hire you must do a small test: build the login and booking screens. We will choose the best one.

Contact me on WhatsApp to discuss faster.
state.profile:
Demo profile — replace with your own.

Full-stack & AI developer, 7 years. Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Python.
- Built a booking + reminders system for a 2-location dental practice: online booking, Twilio SMS reminders, Stripe deposits. No-shows fell from 11% to 4% in 3 months.
- Built and maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations for agencies (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, Google Sheets), incl. lead scoring with an LLM.
- Shipped a RAG assistant over 1,200 policy PDFs for an insurance broker: pgvector, citations, an eval set of 150 questions. Answer accuracy went from 71% to 89% after retrieval tuning.
- React Native (Expo) app for a gym chain, 15k installs.
- AWS (Lambda, RDS, S3) and Vercel; CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Based in Canada (Eastern time).
